title: Bluesky’s AI tool now lets you make games and apps to share on social
slides: Why is Bluesky letting anyone build apps now?
Its new AI tool turns prompts into mini games
But the apps run inside posts, not as standalone stores
You can build and share one without any code today
Try one small game idea before your competitors do
thread_text:
1. Bluesky opens apps to all

Anyone can now build apps that run inside posts, no code needed. The new AI tool turns prompts into playable mini games.

2. Prompt to game in seconds

Describe a game idea in plain text, and the AI generates a working mini game. It's embedded directly in a Bluesky post.

3. No app store, no install

These games live inside posts, not as standalone apps. You play them right in your feed without downloading anything.

4. Build and share today

You don't need coding skills to create one. The tool is live now, so you can publish your game immediately.

5. Try a tiny game idea now

Take one simple game concept and build it with the AI tool this week. If you don't, a competitor might.
